## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/inglis--jane-andrews.md)

[Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) is married to Inglis, having entered the engagement around the time [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Her lavish engagement becomes a topic of gossip in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), drawing criticism from Mrs. [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md).
